scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance of Capital Investment Subsidy to Micro enterprises
other_conditions: Enterprise must be registered or acknowledged by the Ministry of MSME or DPIIT
Enterprise must be a new manufacturing unit or an existing unit undertaking expansion or diversification
Commercial production must have commenced during the operative period (5 Oct 2022 to 4 Oct 2027)
Application must be submitted online within one year of the first loan disbursement, commercial production start, or GR issue date, whichever is later, and before the scheme's last operative date
benefits_summary: Provides a capital investment subsidy of up to 25% of the term loan amount (max ₹35 lakh) for Category 1, 20% (max ₹30 lakh) for Category 2, and 10% (max ₹10 lakh) for other categories.
